verses.text: A psalm of Asaph. God, the nations have invaded the land that belongs to you. They have made your holy temple unclean. They have turned Jerusalem into piles of rubble.
They have left the dead bodies of your servants as food for the birds. They have given the bodies of your faithful people to the wild animals.
They have poured out their blood like water all around Jerusalem, and there is no one left to bury them.
Our neighbours insult us. The people around us laugh at us and make fun of us.
How long, LORD? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy keep burning like fire?
Pour out your anger on the nations that do not know you, on the kingdoms that do not call on your name.
They have eaten up the people of Jacob and destroyed their homeland.
Do not hold the sins of our ancestors against us. Let your mercy come quickly to meet us, because we are in desperate need.
Help us, God our saviour, for the glory of your name. Rescue us and forgive our sins for the honour of your name.
Why should the nations say, "Where is their God?" Let us see you take revenge on the nations for the blood of your servants.
Listen to the groans of the prisoners. With your great power, save those who have been sentenced to death.
Lord, pay back our neighbours seven times over for the insults they have thrown at you.
Then we, your people, the sheep of your pasture, will thank you forever. We will praise you for all generations.
